m1.typescript: m1 sections become chunks that carry their title and section and the version of their document

e1.typescript: e1 a long section splits at sentence ends under the word limit and every part keeps the prefix

e2.typescript: e2 a code outweighs a word and a word in no chunk matches nothing

e3.typescript: e3 a search for a reader never returns a chunk of a document that reader may not see

e4.typescript: e4 the mechanism follows the corpus size then the data shape then the query pattern

e5.typescript: e5 a reindex keeps unchanged documents replaces changed ones adds new ones and drops removed ones

e6.typescript: e6 stale lists the chunks whose document changed or vanished

e7.typescript: e7 recall counts every labelled question and a question with no results is a miss

wrong-no-prefix.defect: leaves the title and section out of the chunk text

wrong-code-weight.defect: scores a code like any other word

wrong-filter-after-cut.defect: applies the access filter after it has taken the best k, so a reader gets fewer results than exist

wrong-always-index.defect: builds an index even for a corpus that fits a cached prompt

wrong-table-chunked.defect: cuts a table into chunks and searches them instead of querying it

wrong-reindex-additive.defect: keeps the old chunks of a document that changed

wrong-reindex-keeps-removed.defect: keeps the chunks of a document that no longer exists

wrong-stale-ignores-removed.defect: does not call the chunks of a removed document stale

wrong-recall-answered-only.defect: divides by the questions that had results instead of all labelled questions
